verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented user control over data retention or deletion: no retention settings, no deletion of conversations or API-stored data, and no opt-out. The only on-topic item states that prompts and responses are saved and stored on xAI's servers. That describes retention, not user control over it. Vague mentions of 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' and 'business plan terms' are adjacent and do not show retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
